title: Leigh Yawkey Woodson Art Museum

services.name: Schedule a Tour
services.desc: Make the most of your visit to the Leigh Yawkey Woodson Art Museum with a scheduled tour. There’s always something new to learn from our ever-changing exhibitions. Offering self-guided visits and docent-led tours, the Woodson Art Museum gives your group options to create a personalized museum experience. Enhance your classroom’s curriculum with a field trip to the Woodson Art Museum! We organize customized class tours that explore current exhibitions while focusing on specific skills and learning objectives. Fill out the form below to request a tour. After we receive your request, one of our team members will contact you shortly to confirm

explain.meaning: Pay for a single class, with no membership or package.
